ref_speedup_note: Anchor 25.48631 calibrated in oracle mode on the authoring CPU lane (Intel Sapphire Rapids). tests/ref_speedup.txt is authoritative at scoring; this file is only the in-image fallback. See tests/ref_speedup.caveat.md to re-measure on your hardware.
target_hardware: cpu (x86-64 Sapphire Rapids; pure-Python stdlib -> no AVX-512 in hot path -> callgrind safe)
value_axis: retired instruction count (Ir) for build+replay of an alloc/free stream against a large pool of many distinct-size freed buffers; a flat pool linear-scans every pooled buffer on each alloc to make its size-exact reuse decision
